title: Compliance policy sets no minimum operating system version

report.title: {Items.Count} compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy has', 'policies have')} no minimum Windows version

messages.businessImpact: A device running a build from several years ago is as compliant as one patched last week, so patch status has no bearing on access.
remediation: Set a minimum operating system version and review it when a build leaves support.
messages.cannotSee: Compliance authored in the Settings Catalog is not read: this tool reads the typed compliance API, so a requirement set in a Settings Catalog compliance policy is invisible here and a tenant that has moved to them is judged only on what it left behind. Whether an unassigned policy is a draft or an oversight is also not visible, and the Assigned to column says which listed policies reach nobody.
